purpose: Reduce time lost on strong jobs with weak or fragile apply paths by resolving the safest canonical response channel before application preparation.
hardLocationRule: Resolver runs only after ba-area or verified remote-ok eligibility. It can never rescue reject-distance or unknown location eligibility.
rules: Never invent an email address, phone number, recruiter, Facebook contact, or application URL.
Do not scrape or expose private contact data; use only contact details intentionally published with the vacancy or official career channel.
If the primary apply link fails, attempt a canonical-source fallback before marking the job non-actionable.
A generic company homepage is not an application channel unless the vacancy explicitly directs applicants there.
Mirror/repost contact data cannot override a working canonical application route.
Store applicationChannelType, applicationChannelUrlOrContact, channelVerifiedAt, and channelConfidence when available.
If no verified channel exists, keep the job LIVE only if fail-closed retention permits it, but block APPLY-FIRST escalation until resolved.

outcomes.apply-ready: At least one verified canonical response channel exists.
outcomes.fallback-ready: Primary route failed but a verified official fallback exists.
outcomes.channel-unknown: No verified response route; requires verification before priority escalation.
outcomes.inactive: Canonical vacancy is closed or explicitly no longer accepting applications.
